sentences.en: A Times investigation into a hospital where doctors suspected that children with complex
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》对一家医院展开了调查，在那里的医生怀疑患有复杂

sentences.en: heart conditions had been dying at higher-than-expected rates and where even children with low-risk conditions seemed to do poorly.
sentences.zh: 心脏病的儿童死亡率高于预期，甚至低风险病情的儿童似乎也情况糟糕。

sentences.en: Secret recordings shared with my colleague Ellen Gabler reveal what was happening inside the hospital.
sentences.zh: 与我的同事埃伦·加布勒分享的秘密录音揭示了医院内部发生的事情。

sentences.en: It's Friday, May 31St.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月31日，星期五。

sentences.en: Well, Skyler, when she was born, how did that go?
sentences.zh: 斯凯勒出生的时候，过程怎么样？

sentences.en: First time I saw her, you know, I fell in love.
sentences.zh: 我第一次见到她时，你知道，我就坠入爱河了。

sentences.en: She came out and she's just like, have her hands up by her face, like she was posing.
sentences.zh: 她生下来的时候，双手就放在脸旁，就像在摆姿势一样。

sentences.en: She came out posing.
sentences.zh: 她出来时就在摆姿势。

sentences.en: She's like, you know, look, I'm pretty.
sentences.zh: 她好像在说，瞧，我很漂亮。

sentences.en: Whatever she was going to do, she was going to be pretty doing it.
sentences.zh: 不管她要做什么，她都会漂漂亮亮地完成。

sentences.en: And so when did you realize that she might have a health problem?
sentences.zh: 那么你是什么时候意识到她可能有健康问题的？

sentences.en: Okay, so she went, I think it was around her three-month appointment at her pediatrician's office.
sentences.zh: 我想大概是在她三个月大去儿科医生那里复诊的时候吧。

sentences.en: And I noticed the one doctor, she said, well, her heart sounds off.
sentences.zh: 我注意到其中一位医生说，她的心音有点不对劲。

sentences.en: Like that rhythm is really off.
sentences.zh: 那个心律真的非常不对劲。

sentences.en: And she said, it could be nothing, but I just want them to just take a look, you know, just look more in depth.
sentences.zh: 她说，可能没什么，但她只是想让他们检查一下，你知道，做更深入的检查。

sentences.en: So Ellen, how did you meet Skyler's parents, the Joneses?
sentences.zh: 埃伦，你是怎么认识斯凯勒的父母琼斯一家的？

sentences.en: So I met Tasha and Thomas last year.
sentences.zh: 我和塔莎还有托马斯是去年认识的。

sentences.en: I was looking into some problems I had heard at North Carolina Children's Hospital.
sentences.zh: 当时我在调查一些我听到的关于北卡罗来纳州儿童医院的问题。

sentences.en: And I knew that their daughter was one of the kids who had had heart surgery there.
sentences.zh: 我知道他们的女儿是在那里做过心脏手术的孩子之一。

sentences.en: I went to the cardiologist's office and they did EKGs.
sentences.zh: 我去了心脏病专科医生的办公室，他们做了心电图。

sentences.en: And when the cardiologist came out and showed us the pictures of her heart, I can remember holding her very, very close to me because I'm just like, no, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 当心脏病专家出来向我们展示她心脏的照片时，我记得我把她抱得非常非常紧，因为我在想，不，我不知道。

sentences.en: And I remember calling my husband when I went and got in the car.
sentences.zh: 我记得上车后给我丈夫打了个电话。

sentences.en: Yeah, I was at work and she called me.
sentences.zh: 对，我当时在上班，她打电话给我。

sentences.en: She was crying.
sentences.zh: 她在哭。

sentences.en: And I was like, what's wrong?
sentences.zh: 我说，怎么了？

sentences.en: She was like, you know, they told her, you know, Skyler had a hole in the heart.
sentences.zh: 她说，你知道的，他们告诉她，斯凯勒的心脏有个洞。

sentences.en: And I was like, what?
sentences.zh: 我说，什么？

sentences.en: So how unusual is it for a parent to hear what Skyler's parents heard?
sentences.zh: 那么，父母听到斯凯勒父母所听到的消息，这种情况有多罕见？

sentences.en: Heart defects are actually the most common birth defect.
sentences.zh: 心脏缺陷实际上是最常见的出生缺陷。

sentences.en: About 40,000 kids every year in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在美国，每年大约有4万名儿童

sentences.en: are born with one.
sentences.zh: 出生时带有这种缺陷。

sentences.en: 10,000 of those kids have to have surgery before they turn one.
sentences.zh: 其中1万名儿童必须在一岁前接受手术。

sentences.en: Skyler's case was a bit different.
sentences.zh: 斯凯勒的情况有点不同。

sentences.en: From what I could understand, she would eventually have to have like a patch of her heart and she should be able to function normally.
sentences.zh: 据我了解，她最终需要做一个心脏修补手术，之后应该就能正常运作了。

sentences.en: What the doctors diagnosed her with was a condition that could wait till she was older.
sentences.zh: 医生诊断她的病情可以等到她长大一点再处理。

sentences.en: And the majority of kids with her condition have surgery and go on to live healthy lives.
sentences.zh: 绝大多数患有她这种病的孩子做完手术后，都能过上健康的生活。

sentences.en: Be able to participate in any sports or whatever she really wanted to do.
sentences.zh: 能够参加任何体育运动或者她真正想做的任何事情。

sentences.en: So with surgery down the line, they continued with the checkups, monitoring her heart.
sentences.zh: 因此，既然手术可以延后，他们就继续进行定期检查，监测她的心脏。

sentences.en: And like fast forward in time.
sentences.zh: 时间快进。

sentences.en: In the spring of 2016.
sentences.zh: 在2016年春天。

sentences.en: I just started noticing like every time you would have her in your chest to chest, I could feel her heartbeat really faSt.
sentences.zh: 我开始注意到，每次把她抱在胸前时，我都能感觉到她的心跳非常快。

sentences.en: Like back to back.
sentences.zh: 一个接一个。

sentences.en: Her heart was racing.
sentences.zh: 她的心跳过速。

sentences.en: She was sweating more than usual.
sentences.zh: 她比平时更容易出汗。

sentences.en: And I'm like, are you okay?
sentences.zh: 我说，你还好吗？

sentences.en: She's like, mommy, I'm tired.
sentences.zh: 她说，妈妈，我累了。

sentences.en: I'm tired.
sentences.zh: 我累了。

sentences.en: And at one of her doctor's appointments, the cardiologist said it was probably time to have surgery soon.
sentences.zh: 在她的一次复诊中，心脏病专家说可能很快就该做手术了。

sentences.en: You know, and I asked them about, you know, the risk.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我向他们询问了关于风险的事情。

sentences.en: We talked about the risk.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论了风险。

sentences.en: You know, and of course, with surgery, it's always a risk, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道，当然，手术总是伴随着风险，对吧？

sentences.en: But the way it was presented, it was more like a simple procedure.
sentences.zh: 但当时介绍的方式，听起来更像是一个简单的手术。

sentences.en: It kind of sounded like it was pretty routine.
sentences.zh: 听起来挺常规的。

sentences.en: The complications for this type of surgery was really low.
sentences.zh: 这种手术的并发症发生率真的很低。

sentences.en: They gave us some available dates that were open.
sentences.zh: 他们给我们提供了一些空闲的可选日期。

sentences.en: And with me, I'm just like, okay, well, if she has to have the surgery, we want to get it fixed and get it out of the way.
sentences.zh: 而我的想法是，好吧，如果她必须做手术，我们想把它治好，免得后顾之忧。

sentences.en: So we won't put her at a risk to have a heart attack or collapse or something else happening to her.
sentences.zh: 这样我们就不会让她面临心脏病发作、晕厥或发生其他意外的风险。

sentences.en: And I'm thinking she should be in good hands because, I mean, just with the reputation, you know, they have good health care.
sentences.zh: 我想她应该会得到很好的照顾，因为仅凭名声就知道，他们的医疗水平很好。

sentences.en: So Tasha's right.
sentences.zh: 所以塔莎说得对。

sentences.en: UNC did have a good reputation, and they still do.
sentences.zh: 北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校医院确实有着良好的声誉，现在也是如此。

sentences.en: But a while ago, I started hearing about some really serious concerns in the pediatric heart surgery department.
sentences.zh: 但不久前，我开始听到一些关于小儿心脏外科部门非常严重的担忧。

sentences.en: And what I was hearing was these cardiologists were hesitant to send their own patients to their own hospital for surgery.
sentences.zh: 我听到的是，这些心脏病专家很犹豫，不敢把自己的病人送到自己医院去做手术。

sentences.en: That's an alarming and concerning thing.
sentences.zh: 这是一件令人震惊且担忧的事情。

sentences.en: And so I wondered what is going on there that's making them feel like this.
sentences.zh: 所以我想知道那里到底发生了什么，才会让他们有这种感觉。

sentences.en: But all of this was happening behind the scenes, inside the hospital, and Tasha and Thomas wouldn't have known any of that when they were setting up Skylar's surgery.
sentences.zh: 但这一切都发生在幕后，在医院内部，塔莎和托马斯在为斯凯勒安排手术时对这一切一无所知。

sentences.en: It was just a random date we just picked.
sentences.zh: 这只是我们随便挑的一个日子。

sentences.en: So they set a date a little before her third birthday.
sentences.zh: 所以他们把日期定在了她三岁生日之前不久。

sentences.en: June 1st and the day before we were taking her in.
sentences.zh: 6月1日，也就是我们送她去医院的前一天。

sentences.en: And I remember I had a hard time sleeping.
sentences.zh: 我记得我很难入睡。

sentences.en: You know, it was just me, her, and Skylar.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当时只有我、她妈妈还有斯凯勒。

sentences.en: So we were just in bed, you know, trying to reSt.
sentences.zh: 所以我们就躺在床上，你知道，试图休息。

sentences.en: But she was balled up in the middle.
sentences.zh: 但她蜷缩在中间。

sentences.en: So we were just sitting there, rubbing on her.
sentences.zh: 我们就坐在那里，抚摸着她。

sentences.en: I can remember asking her, do you know where you're going tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 我记得我问她，你知道明天要去哪里吗？

sentences.en: And she said, I'm going to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 她说，我要去医院。

sentences.en: And I'm like, do you know what you're going to the hospital for?
sentences.zh: 我说，你知道你去医院是为了什么吗？

sentences.en: And she said, my heart.
sentences.zh: 她说，为了我的心脏。

sentences.en: Well, after probably maybe one or two hours of sleep, I think we left the house about 6 o'clock that morning.
sentences.zh: 好吧，在可能睡了一两个小时之后，我想我们在那天早上6点左右离开了家。

sentences.en: Got to UNC Hospital.
sentences.zh: 到达了北卡罗来纳大学医院。

sentences.en: Took us a while to check in because she was just really conversing with the check-in staff.
sentences.zh: 我们花了点时间才办好入院手续，因为她一直在和登记人员愉快地交谈。

sentences.en: Like, you're so pretty.
sentences.zh: 比如，你真漂亮。

sentences.en: And she go, thank you.
sentences.zh: 她说，谢谢你。

sentences.en: And she's like, see my dress.
sentences.zh: 然后她说，看我的裙子。

sentences.en: And she was waving to everybody in the hospital.
sentences.zh: 她向医院里的每个人挥手。

sentences.en: And her little diva wave.
sentences.zh: 她标志性的小明星式挥手。

sentences.en: When we met up with the doctor, we had changed her into the gown.
sentences.zh: 当我们和医生会合时，我们已经给她换上了手术服。

sentences.en: And I can remember her mood just kind of changing.
sentences.zh: 我记得她的情绪开始发生变化。

sentences.en: She was sitting on Thomas when the heart surgeon was talking to her.
sentences.zh: 心脏外科医生跟她说话时，她正坐在托马斯身上。

sentences.en: I think they put her in the little hospital bed.
sentences.zh: 我想他们把她抱到了小病床上。

sentences.en: I think they're taking her vitals.
sentences.zh: 我想他们在给她量生命体征。

sentences.en: But she had got really quiet.
sentences.zh: 但她变得非常安静。

sentences.en: She wasn't her bubbly self anymore.
sentences.zh: 她不再是那个活泼的自己了。

sentences.en: And then it's like, okay, you ready to go?
sentences.zh: 然后就像是，好了，准备好走了吗？

sentences.en: When she was walking down the hall, you could hear her yelling for her dad.
sentences.zh: 当她顺着走廊走时，你能听到她大喊着找爸爸。

sentences.en: She just wanted her daddy.
sentences.zh: 她只是想要她的爸爸。

sentences.en: She's like, I want my daddy.
sentences.zh: 她说，我要爸爸。

sentences.en: Daddy.
sentences.zh: 爸爸。

sentences.en: And I was just, I was thinking, should I just run out of the house with her?
sentences.zh: 我当时就在想，我是不是该带着她逃出医院？

sentences.en: Should I just take her and just say we just had to come back another time?
sentences.zh: 我是不是该带着她，说我们改天再来？

sentences.en: I was almost at that point.
sentences.zh: 我当时几乎就要那样做了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I get kind of emotional with that part.
sentences.zh: 是的，提到这一段我还是有点情绪激动。

sentences.en: But I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 但不好意思。

sentences.en: Because that was really the last time we heard her voice.
sentences.zh: 因为那真的是我们最后一次听到她的声音。

sentences.en: Her normal voice.
sentences.zh: 她平常的声音。

sentences.en: The biggest thing I remember is we was in the waiting room.
sentences.zh: 我记得最深的是我们在候诊室里。

sentences.en: And I felt really nervous.
sentences.zh: 我感到非常紧张。

sentences.en: Just really anxious.
sentences.zh: 非常焦虑。

sentences.en: Because of course we was waiting for the doctor to come out.
sentences.zh: 因为我们当然在等医生出来。

sentences.en: No one came out and gave us any type of update.
sentences.zh: 没有人出来给我们任何形式的更新。

sentences.en: And it actually took longer than it originally said.
sentences.zh: 而且实际上比最初预计的时间要长。

sentences.en: I mean, it lasted all day.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这持续了一整天。

sentences.en: I remember going to the pre-op desk and kind of asking them, like, you know, somebody's going to come and tell us something.
sentences.zh: 我记得我去术前服务台问他们，你知道的，总会有人出来告诉我们点什么吧。

sentences.en: And said someone will come out and talk to us soon.
sentences.zh: 他们说很快会有人出来跟我们谈谈。

sentences.en: And what happened when the surgeon came out to update you?
sentences.zh: 当外科医生出来向你们通报情况时发生了什么？

sentences.en: Yeah, I said everything went fine and she should be coming out anytime now.
sentences.zh: 是的，我说一切都很顺利，她随时都会出来。

sentences.en: So, Ellen, what happened?
sentences.zh: 那么，埃伦，到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, it's hard to know for sure because we weren't in the room.
sentences.zh: 嗯，很难确切知道，因为我们当时不在房间里。

sentences.en: But I do have Skylar's medical records.
sentences.zh: 但我有斯凯勒的病历。

sentences.en: Her parents shared them with me.
sentences.zh: 她的父母与我分享了这些。

sentences.en: And I had some heart surgeons look them over to help me understand what was going on.
sentences.zh: 我请了一些心脏外科医生仔细查看，以帮助我了解发生了什么。

sentences.en: And the first thing is, Skylar had been misdiagnosed.
sentences.zh: 首先，斯凯勒被误诊了。

sentences.en: Tasha and Thomas were initially told that Skylar had a hole in her heart.
sentences.zh: 塔莎和托马斯最初被告知斯凯勒心脏上有个洞。

sentences.en: In fact, her condition was a bit more complicated.
sentences.zh: 事实上，她的病情要复杂一些。

sentences.en: A vessel going into the right side of her heart wasn't fully enclosed, letting blood leak into the wrong chamber.
sentences.zh: 通往她右心的一根血管没有完全闭合，导致血液泄漏到了错误的腔室中。

sentences.en: And so that had to be fixed during the surgery.
sentences.zh: 所以这必须在手术中修复。

sentences.en: But it's still considered pretty low risk.
sentences.zh: 但这仍然被认为风险相当低。

sentences.en: The mortality rate is about 2%.
sentences.zh: 死亡率约为2%。

sentences.en: So most kids who go through this surgery come out okay.
sentences.zh: 所以大部分经历这个手术的孩子都会平安无事。

sentences.en: Yeah, they generally do.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们通常如此。

sentences.en: But after surgery, Skylar was wheeled into intensive care.
sentences.zh: 但在手术后，斯凯勒被用轮床推进了重症监护室。

sentences.en: And a few hours later...
sentences.zh: 几个小时后……

sentences.en: She was awake and I felt like she was in pain.
sentences.zh: 她醒了，我觉得她在痛苦中。

sentences.en: She started to have some serious probleMs.
sentences.zh: 她开始出现一些严重的问题。

sentences.en: And then I kind of start regretting, like, did we do the right thing?
sentences.zh: 然后我开始后悔，我们做的是正确的决定吗？

sentences.en: Over the next couple hours, that's when things get really bad.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几个小时里，情况开始变得非常糟糕。

sentences.en: The machines that Skylar is hooked up to start going crazy.
sentences.zh: 连接着斯凯勒的机器开始疯狂报警。

sentences.en: Next thing you know, people just run in a room and I'm kind of looking around like, what the heck is happening?
sentences.zh: 接下来你知道发生什么了吗，人们突然冲进房间，而我四处张望，心想：这到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: Skylar goes into cardiac arreSt.
sentences.zh: 斯凯勒突发心脏骤停。

sentences.en: Doctors and nurses swarm her bed and start doing CPR.
sentences.zh: 医生和护士蜂拥至她的床前，开始实施心肺复苏。

sentences.en: Thomas had pulled Tasha out of the room so she didn't have to watch what was happening to their daughter.
sentences.zh: 托马斯把塔莎拉出了房间，这样她就不用眼睁睁看着女儿经历这一切。

sentences.en: Skylar gets CPR for almost an hour.
sentences.zh: 斯凯勒接受了近一个小时的心肺复苏。

sentences.en: And that night, she was put on life support.
sentences.zh: 当天晚上，她被送上了生命支持系统。

sentences.en: So, while Skylar's in the ICU, one floor down, there's another crisis brewing.
sentences.zh: 因此，正当斯凯勒在重症监护室抢救时，楼下正酝酿着另一场危机。

sentences.en: A group of doctors are in a meeting.
sentences.zh: 一群医生正在开会。

sentences.en: They're sitting around this conference table.
sentences.zh: 他们围坐在会议桌旁。

sentences.en: It's almost the entire pediatric cardiology team at UNC.
sentences.zh: 几乎涵盖了北卡罗来纳大学的所有小儿心脏病学团队成员。

sentences.en: The goals are to, and maybe of this meeting, is to figure out where to go from here.
sentences.zh: 这次会议的目标之一，或许也是为了弄清楚接下来该何去何从。

sentences.en: And they're really worried.
sentences.zh: 而且他们非常焦虑。

sentences.en: They're worried about the patients that they see coming out of surgery.
sentences.zh: 他们担心那些刚做完手术的病人。

sentences.en: Somebody at the hospital is so worried that they secretly record the meeting.
sentences.zh: 医院里的某个人实在太担心了，以至于偷偷录下了这次会议。

sentences.en: And later pass that recording on to me.
sentences.zh: 后来又把录音转交给了我。

sentences.en: What would make someone so worried that they would want to secretly record this meeting?
sentences.zh: 究竟是什么让一个人如此担忧，甚至想要秘密录下这场会议？

sentences.en: Well, when you listen to these recordings, you can hear in the doctor's voices, they're really struggling with what to do with their patients, these patients who need surgery.
sentences.zh: 当你听这些录音时，你可以从医生的声音中听出，他们在面对需要手术的病患时，内心做决定时真的非常纠结。

sentences.en: Now, just to be clear, these are cardiologists.
sentences.zh: 顺便说明一下，这些人是心脏病专家。

sentences.en: They diagnose and treat heart problems, but they don't do the surgeries.
sentences.zh: 他们负责诊断和治疗心脏问题，但不做手术。

sentences.en: They refer their cases to surgeons, either at UNC or sometimes a different hospital.
sentences.zh: 他们会将病例转诊给外科医生，要么在北卡罗来纳大学，有时则在其他医院。

sentences.en: And some of the kids coming out of surgery at UNC, they're not doing well.
sentences.zh: 有些在北卡罗来纳大学做完手术的孩子，情况并不乐观。

sentences.en: You've got Skylar upstairs on life support.
sentences.zh: 楼上还有靠生命支持系统维持生命的斯凯勒。

sentences.en: Right before Skylar, a newborn girl died after having surgery.
sentences.zh: 就在斯凯勒出事前不久，一名刚出生不久的女婴在手术后不幸夭折。

sentences.en: Two other kids with low-risk surgeries had complications.
sentences.zh: 另外两个低风险手术的孩子也出现了并发症。

sentences.en: A baby boy died after a valve in his heart appeared to have been damaged during surgery.
sentences.zh: 一名男婴在手术中疑似心脏瓣膜受损后死亡。

sentences.en: These are the kinds of problems that the cardiologists at UNC are seeing.
sentences.zh: 这就是北卡罗来纳大学的心脏病专家们所面对的种种问题。

sentences.en: I asked myself, would I have my children have surgery here?
sentences.zh: 我问自己，我会让自己的孩子在这里做手术吗？

sentences.en: In the past, I'd always felt like the answer was yes for something simple.
sentences.zh: 过去，如果是做一些简单的手术，我的答案一直是肯定的。

sentences.en: But now when I look myself in the mirror and what's gone on the past month, I can't say that.
sentences.zh: 但现在，当我看着镜子里的自己，回想过去一个月发生的事情，我无法再给出肯定的答案。

sentences.en: And if I can't say it for my kids, and that should be our group discussion.
sentences.zh: 如果我连自己的孩子都无法保证，这就应该成为我们集体讨论的议题。

sentences.en: If we can't all look ourselves in the mirror and think we're doing the right thing, we need to change what we're doing.
sentences.zh: 如果我们不能集体反省并认为自己在做正确的事，我们就必须改变我们的做法。

sentences.en: They're especially upset about another little girl who needed a heart transplant.
sentences.zh: 他们对另一个需要心脏移植的小女孩感到人格外愤怒。

sentences.en: And when an organ became available, apparently the chief surgeon at the time, he's the surgeon who operated on Skylar, didn't come in to do the transplant.
sentences.zh: 当有器官可用时，当时的首席外科医生——也就是给斯凯勒做手术的那位医生——竟然没有来做这场移植手术。

sentences.en: As a mother of three children, oh my God, it's inexcusable.
sentences.zh: 作为三个孩子的母亲，我的天哪，这简直不可原谅。

sentences.en: As a physician, I mean, we all took the oath.
sentences.zh: 作为一名医生，我的意思是，我们都宣过誓。

sentences.en: What you're supposed to do is write for our patients.
sentences.zh: 你们该做的事是为病人争取权益。

sentences.en: This is what you signed up for.
sentences.zh: 这就是你们当初选择这个职业的初衷。

sentences.en: And who is he to play God with some kid's life?
sentences.zh: 他算老几，竟然敢拿孩子的生命开玩笑？

sentences.en: I can't get past this.
sentences.zh: 我无法释怀。

sentences.en: This is beyond horrifying.
sentences.zh: 这简直骇人听闻。

sentences.en: So wait, a transplant suddenly becomes available, and the doctor just doesn't come in and do it.
sentences.zh: 等等，移植供体突然出现了，而医生居然不来做手术。

sentences.en: Well, the doctors ask their boss, the chief of their division, if there's some sort of explanation for this.
sentences.zh: 医生们向他们的上司，也就是科室主任询问，这其中是否有某种解释。

sentences.en: Well, is there a story that we just have not been privy to yet?
sentences.zh: 难道有什么内情是我们还不知道的吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: This is really pretty awful.
sentences.zh: 这确实相当糟糕。

sentences.en: It is pretty awful.
sentences.zh: 确实很糟糕。

sentences.en: He didn't really have an answer for them.
sentences.zh: 他根本给不出什么合理的解释。

sentences.en: And I also asked the hospital about this, and they said that they can't share personnel information, but generally, no surgeon can be on call 365 days a year.
sentences.zh: 我也就此事询问了医院，他们表示不能透露人事信息，但一般来说，没有哪个外科医生能做到一年365天随叫随到。

sentences.en: Of course, I also asked the surgeon himself, but he declined to comment.
sentences.zh: 当然，我也联系了外科医生本人，但他拒绝置评。

sentences.en: But the doctors in this meeting are upset because if they have patients who need transplants, they need to be assured that there's going to be a surgeon around to do them.
sentences.zh: 但参会的医生们之所以愤怒，是因为如果他们有需要移植的病人，他们需要得到保证：会有外科医生来做手术。

sentences.en: And not only are the doctors in this meeting worried about the chief surgeon who did most of the operations at this time.
sentences.zh: 而且，参会的医生们担心的不仅是当时主刀绝大多数手术的首席外科医生。

sentences.en: Nobody has their head in the sand, like, they're not aware that the lack of cardiac intensivists and the lack of nurses and the lack of...
sentences.zh: 没有人愚蠢到掩耳盗铃的程度，他们并非没有意识到缺乏小儿心脏重症监护医生、缺乏护士以及缺乏……

sentences.en: They're also worried about the whole system of care.
sentences.zh: 他们同样在担忧整个医疗护理体系。

sentences.en: The house is in total disarray.
sentences.zh: 整个医院一团糟。

sentences.en: This is crazy what we're doing.
sentences.zh: 我们现在的做法太荒唐了。

sentences.en: I should be as pissed as anybody.
sentences.zh: 我应该和任何人一样愤怒。

sentences.en: In fact, maybe more.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能比谁都气愤。

sentences.en: I've never seen anything like it, quite frankly.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，我从未见过这样的情况。

sentences.en: You mean everything related to kids having heart surgery at UNC?
sentences.zh: 你是说所有与北卡罗来纳大学儿童心脏手术相关的事情？

sentences.en: Yeah, it's really hard to pinpoint one specific thing that's going wrong because heart surgery is really complicated, right?
sentences.zh: 是的，很难确切指出究竟是哪一个环节出了问题，因为心脏手术真的很复杂，对吧？

sentences.en: Think about all the people involved.
sentences.zh: 想想所有涉及的人员。

sentences.en: You've got the surgeons, the anesthesiologists, people running the heart and lung machine during the surgery.
sentences.zh: 有外科医生、麻醉师，还有在手术中负责操作心肺机的人。

sentences.en: You've got the nurses, the doctors in intensive care, the cardiologists.
sentences.zh: 还有护士、重症监护医生、心脏病专家。

sentences.en: So it's a lot of people and a lot of things that need to work exactly right in order for things to go well for these kids.
sentences.zh: 所以有太多的人，也有太多的环节必须万无一失，这些孩子才能顺利度过难关。

sentences.en: And the research actually shows that kids, especially with complex conditions, usually do better in hospitals that do a lot of these surgeries.
sentences.zh: 研究确实表明，孩子们，尤其是病情复杂的孩子，通常在做这类手术较多的医院里恢复得更好。

sentences.en: So if you're a hospital like UNC that's competing with a neighboring hospital, which they are, and actually a lot of hospitals in the country are,
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你像北卡罗来纳大学这样，正在与邻近的医院竞争——事实也确实如此，而且全国很多医院都是如此——

sentences.en: then it can be really hard to get enough patients so you have the volume that you need to get the best possible outcomes.
sentences.zh: 那么，要获得足够多的病源，从而达到取得最佳治疗效果所需的病例数量，就会非常困难。

sentences.en: So it's hard to say exactly why a patient wouldn't do well.
sentences.zh: 所以很难确切说出为什么某个患者的情况会不理想。

sentences.en: What I can tell you is that some of the doctors in this meeting worried that the hospital was under-resourced in terms of staffing and training,
sentences.zh: 我能告诉你的是，参会的一些医生担心医院在人员配备和培训方面资源不足，

sentences.en: and that the hospital was taking on patients it wasn't equipped to handle.
sentences.zh: 并且医院接收了超出了其救治能力的病人。

sentences.en: But these doctors, they didn't have the evidence to back up their hunch.
sentences.zh: 但这些医生并没有确凿的证据来支撑他们的直觉。

sentences.en: And that's where this recording gets really interesting.
sentences.zh: 这也是这段录音最引人入胜的地方。

sentences.en: I think one thing we can demand from Michael, demand in the short term, transparency in terms of the outcome,
sentences.zh: 我认为我们可以对迈克尔提出的一点要求，短期内需要提出的要求，就是治疗结果的透明度，

sentences.en: in terms of the honestly telling patients what the actual outcomes are.
sentences.zh: 也就是诚实地告诉患者实际的治疗效果。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So one of the ways that hospitals figure out how they are doing at these surgeries is they collect all kinds of data about every single surgery,
sentences.zh: 因此，医院了解自身心脏手术水平的方法之一，就是收集关于每一台手术的各种数据，

sentences.en: like the weight of the baby, if the baby was premature, if there were any genetic abnormalities, things like that.
sentences.zh: 比如婴儿的体重、是否早产、是否存在任何基因异常，诸如此类的信息。

sentences.en: And they send all this data to an outside organization, and that organization makes sure all the data is accurate, and they analyze it, and they give a report back to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 然后他们将所有这些数据发送给一个外部机构，该机构负责确保所有数据的准确性，进行分析，并向医院反馈一份报告。

sentences.en: And in that report is something called risk-adjusted data.
sentences.zh: 该报告中包含一项名为“风险调整数据”的内容。

sentences.en: And what is that, risk-adjusted data?
sentences.zh: 那是什么，风险调整数据？

sentences.en: So it's basically trying to account for the individual risks of a particular patient.
sentences.zh: 这基本上是为了考量特定患者的个体风险。

sentences.en: And so that way, you know, a hospital handling the more complex patients, it's understood that they are going to have a higher mortality rate.
sentences.zh: 这样一来，你知道的，一家收治更复杂病例的医院，人们就会理解他们的死亡率自然会更高一些。

sentences.en: It kind of takes the riskiness of what's going on here into account and makes sure that that's part of the data.
sentences.zh: 它将这里所涉病例的风险因素考虑在内，并确保其成为数据的一部分。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So the other important thing to know is that it can help show if low-risk patients are dying more than they should.
sentences.zh: 另一个需要了解的重要事情是，它有助于揭示低风险患者的死亡率是否超出了应有的水平。

sentences.en: Almost every hospital in the country that does pediatric heart surgeries sends this data in to that organization.
sentences.zh: 全国几乎所有开展小儿心脏手术的医院都会将这些数据发送给那个机构。

sentences.en: But only 75% of hospitals make this data public.
sentences.zh: 但只有75%的医院会将这些数据公之于众。

sentences.en: The other 25% of hospitals in the country don't share this data.
sentences.zh: 全国另外25%的医院没有分享这些数据。

sentences.en: UNC falls into that category.
sentences.zh: 北卡罗来纳大学就属于这一类。

sentences.en: What's especially strange at UNC at the time of this meeting is even these cardiologists can't get the mortality data for their own hospital.
sentences.zh: 在这次会议召开时，北卡罗来纳大学最奇怪的地方在于，甚至连这些心脏病专家都无法获取他们自己医院的死亡率数据。

sentences.en: That's really strange-sounding.
sentences.zh: 听起来真的很诡异。

sentences.en: How is that possible?
sentences.zh: 这怎么可能？

sentences.en: Well, I finally figured out that the hospital hadn't been submitting data to that outside organization.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我最终发现，这家医院一直没有向那个外部机构提交数据。

sentences.en: Because the person whose job it was to do that, they left.
sentences.zh: 因为负责这项工作的人离职了。

sentences.en: And the position hadn't been filled for quite a while.
sentences.zh: 而且这个职位空缺了相当长的一段时间。

sentences.en: And the cardiologists are aware of this.
sentences.zh: 心脏病专家们也意识到了这一点。

sentences.en: But they still feel like there should be some basic mortality data that someone is collecting, likely the chief surgeon.
sentences.zh: 但他们仍然觉得，应该有人在收集一些基本的死亡率数据，这个人很可能就是首席外科医生。

sentences.en: That's often something that surgeons do.
sentences.zh: 这通常是外科医生会做的事情。

sentences.en: So, they've been asking for some data, but they say they're not getting what they need.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们一直在索取一些数据，但他们说并没有得到他们需要的东西。

sentences.en: So, the hospital is not sending in this data.
sentences.zh: 所以，医院根本没有提交这些数据。

sentences.en: It's not getting a report back.
sentences.zh: 也没有收到任何反馈报告。

sentences.en: Which means the doctors can't share this UNC mortality data with parents because they don't have it.
sentences.zh: 这意味着医生无法与家长分享北卡罗来纳大学的死亡率数据，因为他们根本没有。

sentences.en: So, I don't know what they're sharing with parents, but what I do know is that eventually UNC was able to submit that backlog data.
sentences.zh: 所以，我不知道他们跟家长分享了什么，但我所知道的是，北卡罗来纳大学最终还是提交了那些积压的数据。

sentences.en: And about seven months after this meeting, the doctors were able to look at some of it.
sentences.zh: 大约在这场会议结束七个月后，医生们终于能看到其中的一部分数据了。

sentences.en: And what did that data show?
sentences.zh: 这些数据说明了什么？

sentences.en: So, I tried for over a year to get this information.
sentences.zh: 为此，我花了长达一年多的时间来获取这些信息。

sentences.en: And UNC denied my request to the point that the New York Times decided to sue them.
sentences.zh: 北卡罗来纳大学甚至拒绝了我的请求，以至于《纽约时报》决定起诉他们。

sentences.en: And just recently, I finally did get UNC to release some information.
sentences.zh: 就在最近，我终于迫使北卡罗来纳大学公布了一些信息。

sentences.en: And what does it show?
sentences.zh: 这些数据揭示了什么？

sentences.en: So, for a four-year period through June of 2017,
sentences.zh: 在截至2017年6月的四年期间里，

sentences.en: UNC had a higher death rate for pediatric heart surgeries than nearly all of the other hospitals around the country that publicly report this information.
sentences.zh: 北卡罗来纳大学的小儿心脏手术死亡率，几乎高于全国所有公开披露这一信息的其他医院。

sentences.en: Other hospitals have mortality rates as low as 1% or 2%.
sentences.zh: 其他医院的死亡率低至1%或2%。

sentences.en: And so, for UNC, from the data that they gave me, their mortality rate was 4.7%.
sentences.zh: 因此，根据北卡罗来纳大学提供给我的数据，他们的死亡率高达4.7%。

sentences.en: Now, that's just the raw number.
sentences.zh: 当然，这只是个原始数字。

sentences.en: That's the number of kids who died out of the total number of surgeries.
sentences.zh: 也就是在总手术量中夭折的孩子数量。

sentences.en: The information that they won't give me, which 75% of hospitals already make public, is that risk-adjusted data.
sentences.zh: 而他们坚决不肯向我提供的信息——也就是75%的医院已经公开的——正是那种风险调整数据。

sentences.en: Why won't they give you that information?
sentences.zh: 他们为什么不肯提供这些信息？

sentences.en: Well, because they say it's not risk-adjusted enough.
sentences.zh: 因为他们说这些数据“风险调整得不够充分”。

sentences.en: I'm trying to understand what that means.
sentences.zh: 我正试图理解这句话的意思。

sentences.en: Data that is adjusted for the risk factors of the population that they take care of, their argument is that it doesn't do enough adjusting for that risk.
sentences.zh: 针对他们所治疗患者的风险因素进行过调整的数据，他们的说辞是，这种调整对于这些风险来说还远远不够。

sentences.en: That's what they're saying.
sentences.zh: 他们就是这么辩解的。

sentences.en: They say that they take care of some of the sickest patients.
sentences.zh: 他们声称自己收治的都是病情最危重的患者。

sentences.en: They say they take care of a lot of low-income patients.
sentences.zh: 他们还声称自己收治了大量低收入患者。

sentences.en: The problem, though, is that hospitals throughout the country, including ones that publicly report this information, they also take care of really sick patients.
sentences.zh: 然而问题在于，全国各地的医院，包括那些公开披露这些信息的医院，同样也在收治病情极其危重的患者。

sentences.en: They also take care of low-income kids.
sentences.zh: 他们同样也在救治低收入家庭的孩子。

sentences.en: I have to say,
sentences.zh: 我必须得说，

sentences.en: the fact that they're arguing this point does make you wonder if they are worried that this risk-adjusted number that they don't want you to see might be very unflattering.
sentences.zh: 他们抛出这个论点，确实让人不禁怀疑：他们是不是在担心，那个他们不让你看到的风险调整后数字，可能会非常难看？

sentences.en: So, that might be the case, but that's why I want to see this data.
sentences.zh: 情况或许确实如此，但这正是我想看到这些数据的原因。

sentences.en: And the other thing they say is that it's not fair to compare them to other hospitals because the data isn't really statistically significant,
sentences.zh: 他们找的另一个借口是，将他们与其他医院进行对比并不公平，因为数据在统计学上并不显著，

sentences.en: meaning there's no real difference between them and another hospital.
sentences.zh: 意思是他们和其他医院之间并没有实质性的差异。

sentences.en: But, I mean, if you're a parent and you have a sick kid, or if you're a cardiologist and you have to refer that kid for surgery, this is information you should be able to get.
sentences.zh: 但是，说真的，如果你是一位父母，孩子正饱受病痛折磨，或者你是一位需要将患儿转诊做手术的心脏病专家，这是你应该能够获取的信息。

sentences.en: And it's a nightmare right now.
sentences.zh: 而现在的局势简直是一场噩梦。

sentences.en: I mean, it really is.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，确实如此。

sentences.en: And we are in crisis, and everyone is aware of that.
sentences.zh: 我们正处于危机之中，每个人都心知肚明。

sentences.en: So, that guy saying it's a nightmare, that's Dr. Tim Hoffman.
sentences.zh: 刚才说这是场噩梦的那个人，是蒂姆·霍夫曼医生（Dr. Tim Hoffman）。

sentences.en: He's the chief of pediatric cardiology.
sentences.zh: 他是小儿心脏病学科主任。

sentences.en: And he's the most senior person in that meeting.
sentences.zh: 也是那场会议中资历最高的人。

sentences.en: So, the concern among the doctors has reached pretty senior levels in the cardiology department.
sentences.zh: 因此，医生们的担忧已经上升到了心脏病学的高层管理层面。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We are going to be slightly different in the next two years.
sentences.zh: 在未来两年里，我们将会有所不同。

sentences.en: I don't know if that means we're going to be without a surgical program, with one or not.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这意味着我们会失去外科项目，还是会保留一个等等。

sentences.en: But, I mean, this is it.
sentences.zh: 但我的意思是，就是这样。

sentences.en: This is the fork in the road.
sentences.zh: 我们正站在十字路口。

sentences.en: So, as the meeting ends...
sentences.zh: 随着会议接近尾声……

sentences.en: I will meet with Kevin, and we'll go from there.
sentences.zh: 我将与凯文会面，然后我们再作打算。

sentences.en: Dr. Hoffman says he's going to take these issues to someone named Kevin Kelly.
sentences.zh: 霍夫曼医生表示，他会将这些问题带去跟一个叫凯文·凯利（Kevin Kelly）的人谈。

sentences.en: That's the head of the Children's Hospital at the time.
sentences.zh: 那正是当时儿童医院的负责人。

sentences.en: So, these doctors are facing an ethical dilemma here.
sentences.zh: 所以，这些医生在这里面临着伦理困境。

sentences.en: Something seems to be going wrong within their own hospital.
sentences.zh: 他们自己的医院内部似乎正出现严重的问题。

sentences.en: And it's putting young patients at risk.
sentences.zh: 而这正将年幼的患者置于危险之中。

sentences.en: And they're wrestling with how exactly to proceed and to call it out.
sentences.zh: 他们正在纠结究竟该如何推进以及如何公开说出来。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And that dilemma only intensifies.
sentences.zh: 这种两难的境地愈发严重。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程式？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，而且不需要绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程式时，你在该应用程式内的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程式，即可免费使用 30 天。

sentences.en: So, three weeks after the doctors' first meet, they gather again.
sentences.zh: 因此，在医生们首次会面三周后，他们再次聚在一起。

sentences.en: This time with Kevin Kelly, the head of the Children's Hospital.
sentences.zh: 这一次，儿童医院院长凯文·凯利也参加了。

sentences.en: I encourage you to be open with me if you feel comfortable.
sentences.zh: 如果你们觉得舒适，我鼓励你们对我畅所欲言。

sentences.en: If you're not comfortable, that's fine too.
sentences.zh: 如果你们觉得不自在，那也没关系。

sentences.en: This meeting is also secretly recorded, and the tape's a little hard to hear.
sentences.zh: 这次会议也被秘密录音了，磁带的声音有点听不清楚。

sentences.en: I just can't send in more patients.
sentences.zh: 我只是不能再送患者进来了。

sentences.en: But it's clear that the doctors who are there are still really upset.
sentences.zh: 但很明显，在场的医生仍然非常沮丧。

sentences.en: And I'm looking to leadership to come up with it again.
sentences.zh: 我希望领导层能再次提出解决方案。

sentences.en: They don't have access to the mortality data.
sentences.zh: 他们无法获取死亡率数据。

sentences.en: They're conflicted about where they should be referring patients, and they want leadership to do something about it.
sentences.zh: 他们对于应该把患者转诊到哪里感到纠结，他们希望领导层能采取行动。

sentences.en: The cardiologists that are talking to you in this room today are saying that we are not on track.
sentences.zh: 今天在这间屋子里跟你谈话的心脏病专家表示，我们偏离了正轨。

sentences.en: And I would argue that we have not been on track for some time.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，我们偏离正轨已经有一段时间了。

sentences.en: And what is his message to these doctors?
sentences.zh: 他对这些医生传达了什么信息？

sentences.en: What you're saying is we've been telling ourselves for years that things are okay, and I actually think the statistics for quite a while were okay.
sentences.zh: 你的意思是，多年来我们一直告诉自己情况一切正常，而我其实觉得统计数据在相当长的一段时间里确实是正常的。

sentences.en: We have just hit a really rocky piece of the road.
sentences.zh: 我们只是遭遇了一段非常坎坷的路程。

sentences.en: So he tells the doctors that they should follow their conscience when it comes to where they refer patients.
sentences.zh: 因此他告诉医生们，在决定将患者转诊到何处时，他们应该听从自己的良心。

sentences.en: It reduces the volume of things.
sentences.zh: 这减少了业务量。

sentences.en: I'll just reduce the number of people that we have.
sentences.zh: 我只能减少我们的人数。

sentences.en: That's all I can do.
sentences.zh: 这就是我能做的全部。

sentences.en: Because all I get to do is manage money.
sentences.zh: 因为我能做的只有管理资金。

sentences.en: Then he says if they start referring too many patients elsewhere, he might have to cut the staff at UNC.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，如果他们开始把太多患者转诊到别处，他可能不得不削减北卡罗来纳大学分校的员工。

sentences.en: Because referring patients elsewhere will cost the hospital money.
sentences.zh: 因为把患者转诊到别处会使医院花钱。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: If there's not enough money coming in, they don't have enough money to support the department.
sentences.zh: 如果进账的资金不够，他们就没有足够的资金来支持这个科室。

sentences.en: So essentially, some doctors feel that he's threatening their jobs.
sentences.zh: 所以本质上，一些医生觉得他在威胁他们的工作。

sentences.en: And he ends the meeting by telling the doctors to keep quiet about it all.
sentences.zh: 他在会议结束时告诉医生们，对这一切要保持沉默。

sentences.en: I suggest you make moral, personal judgments about how you handle cases.
sentences.zh: 我建议你们对如何处理病例做出道德和个人层面的判断。

sentences.en: And when you walk out of here, stop talking about it outside of this room.
sentences.zh: 当你走出这里时，不要再在这个房间之外谈论此事。

sentences.en: Okay, so from June 1st, from the surgery to cardiac arrest to intubation.
sentences.zh: 好的，从 6 月 1 日开始，从手术到心脏骤停再到插管。

sentences.en: And while all this is going on, how is Skylar doing?
sentences.zh: 在这一切发生的同时，斯凯拉情况如何？

sentences.en: Skylar has improved enough to come off life support.
sentences.zh: 斯凯拉的情况有所改善，已经可以撤除生命支持了。

sentences.en: But she has a damaged vocal cord, which can be a complication from surgery or going on life support.
sentences.zh: 但她的声带受损了，这可能是手术或使用生命支持系统的并发症。

sentences.en: And she ends up aspirating, so getting some things into her lungs that she shouldn't.
sentences.zh: 她最终出现了误吸，也就是有一些不该进入肺部的东西进入了肺部。

sentences.en: She ends up getting pneumonia.
sentences.zh: 她最终得了肺炎。

sentences.en: She aspirates again.
sentences.zh: 她再次出现误吸。

sentences.en: And it was like a, I call it a rollercoaster ride.
sentences.zh: 这就像一个，我称之为过山车般的旅程。

sentences.en: Because it was just ups, downs, ups, downs.
sentences.zh: 因为只有上升、下降、上升、下降。

sentences.en: And it was more downs than ups.
sentences.zh: 而且下降的时候比上升的时候多。

sentences.en: I remember her birthday.
sentences.zh: 我记得她的生日。

sentences.en: We were just so upset.
sentences.zh: 我们当时难过极了。

sentences.en: She wasn't even up at that time.
sentences.zh: 那时她甚至都还没有醒来。

sentences.en: They had her down.
sentences.zh: 他们让她躺下了。

sentences.en: The nurses went in there and they sang happy birthday to her at 2-12 that morning.
sentences.zh: 那天早上 2 点 12 分，护士们走进病房，为她唱了生日快乐歌。

sentences.en: They had a decorated room, kind of dressed up a little bit.
sentences.zh: 他们把房间装饰了一下，稍微打扮了一番。

sentences.en: They had her pink little headband around her head in true Skylar fashion.
sentences.zh: 按照斯凯拉一贯的风格，她的头上戴着粉红色的发带。

sentences.en: By the end of July.
sentences.zh: 到了七月底。

sentences.en: That morning of July 30th, she was just so happy.
sentences.zh: 7 月 30 日那天早上，她开心极了。

sentences.en: Skylar is doing a lot better.
sentences.zh: 斯凯拉的情况好多了。

sentences.en: She's alert.
sentences.zh: 她很清醒。

sentences.en: She's gotten out of bed a few times.
sentences.zh: 她已经下床好几次了。

sentences.en: She likes to have her hair braided and nails painted by the nurses.
sentences.zh: 她喜欢让护士给她梳辫子、涂指甲油。

sentences.en: And her parents think she's doing pretty well.
sentences.zh: 她的父母认为她恢复得相当不错。

sentences.en: We had pretty much locked in a home health nursing agency.
sentences.zh: 我们几乎已经确定了一家居家护理机构。

sentences.en: So it was going to be set up for like when we were going home.
sentences.zh: 所以一切都将准备就绪，就像我们要回家时一样。

sentences.en: But on one of her last days in the hospital, we were watching, I think it was VeggieTales.
sentences.zh: 但在她在医院的最后几天里，我们正在看，我想是《蔬菜总动员》吧。

sentences.en: That was her favorite videos.
sentences.zh: 那是她最喜欢的录像带。

sentences.en: She starts to have really serious probleMs.
sentences.zh: 她开始出现非常严重的问题。

sentences.en: And I was just sitting there right beside her in the bed.
sentences.zh: 我当时就坐在她床边。

sentences.en: And I was actually going to go down the street to one of the salons and get my hair like washed and everything.
sentences.zh: 我原本打算去街上的一家美发沙龙洗头发什么的。

sentences.en: And I had turned around and she was looking at me.
sentences.zh: 我转过身去，她正看着我。

sentences.en: And blood started coming out of her mouth and her eyes started rolling in the back of her head.
sentences.zh: 血开始从她嘴里涌出来，她的双眼向上翻去。

sentences.en: And then her stash just kind of dipped.
sentences.zh: 然后她的生命体征监测仪突然直线下降。

sentences.en: And I'm kind of like, oh my God.
sentences.zh: 我当时整个人都惊呆了，天哪。

sentences.en: I ran out and got one of the nurses.
sentences.zh: 我跑出去找了一个护士。

sentences.en: They saw the little blood spill coming out of her mouth.
sentences.zh: 他们看到血从她嘴里溢出来。

sentences.en: And I kind of got pushed, you know, out of the way.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我被推到了一边。

sentences.en: And right before they wheeled her off, you know, I remember just kissing her and kind of loving on her and stuff before they took her back.
sentences.zh: 就在他们推走她之前，你知道的，我记得我只是吻了吻她，在他们把她带回去之前抱了抱她、疼爱了她一番。

sentences.en: And I was just telling her, you know, that we loved her.
sentences.zh: 我当时只是对她说，你知道的，我们很爱她。

sentences.en: And like I just remember she had, we just kept locking her eyes.
sentences.zh: 我只记得她有，我们一直在对视。

sentences.en: And I remember them rolling her off and she was still looking.
sentences.zh: 我记得他们推走她时，她还在看着。

sentences.en: And she pretty much, I mean, from the OR, that was our last time seeing it when they rolled her off.
sentences.zh: 基本上，我是说，从手术室出来后，当他们推走她时，那是我们最后一次见到她。

sentences.en: Does your reporting show that the hospital is responsible for Skylar's death?
sentences.zh: 你们的报道是否显示医院对斯凯拉的死负有责任？

sentences.en: So it's hard to know.
sentences.zh: 所以这很难说。

sentences.en: There's always risk when you do surgery.
sentences.zh: 做手术总是有风险的。

sentences.en: And there are all kinds of reasons that a kid might not make it or might have complications.
sentences.zh: 孩子没能挺过来或出现并发症的原因各种各样。

sentences.en: But Skylar was an otherwise pretty healthy kid undergoing a relatively low-risk surgery.
sentences.zh: 但斯凯拉原本是个相当健康的孩子，接受的是一台风险相对较低的手术。

sentences.en: And she ended up having all these complications and ultimately died.
sentences.zh: 而她最后却出现了所有这些并发症，并最终死亡。

sentences.en: That's the reason why this data is so important.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么这些数据如此重要。

sentences.en: So we can find out if situations like Skylar are happening on a broader scale.
sentences.zh: 这样我们就能查明像斯凯拉这样的情况是否在更大范围内发生。

sentences.en: And, you know, of course, I asked UNC about Skylar's case.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我当然就斯凯拉的病例询问了北卡罗来纳大学分校。

sentences.en: And they said that because they are a health institution, they're prohibited by law, like other health institutions, from talking about private patient information.
sentences.zh: 他们表示，由于他们是一家医疗机构，与其他医疗机构一样，法律禁止他们谈论患者的隐私信息。

sentences.en: But I also asked them if Skylar's parents signed a release, if they could talk with me about her situation.
sentences.zh: 但我也问过他们，如果斯凯拉的父母签署了发布授权书，他们是否可以和我讨论她的情况。

sentences.en: But they declined to do so.
sentences.zh: 但他们拒绝这样做。

sentences.en: So what has UNC said about your reporting here?
sentences.zh: 那么北卡罗来纳大学分校对你们这里的报道作何回应？

sentences.en: They said that they did their own investigation at the time and found that the criticisms of the program were unsubstantiated and that there were never any problems affecting patient care.
sentences.zh: 他们表示，他们在当时进行了自己的调查，发现对该项目的批评是没有依据的，并且从未发生过任何影响患者护理的问题。

sentences.en: They did say that there was a dysfunctional group at the time and team culture issues.
sentences.zh: 他们确实承认当时存在一个功能失调的群体以及团队文化问题。

sentences.en: They say that they've always been making improvements to their program and they're continuing to do that.
sentences.zh: 他们表示，他们一直在对项目进行改进，并且将继续这样做。

sentences.en: They hired a new chief surgeon last summer.
sentences.zh: 他们在去年夏天聘请了一位新的首席外科医生。

sentences.en: They said it was because the one who was there was nearing retirement.
sentences.zh: 他们说这是因为原先的那位即将退休。

sentences.en: They said they've made other leadership changes, too.
sentences.zh: 他们说他们也进行了其他领导层变动。

sentences.en: And they have a very strong program today and they're proud of it.
sentences.zh: 他们如今拥有一个非常强大的项目，并且为此感到自豪。

sentences.en: But in the end, they are still unwilling to release this really important data.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，他们仍然不愿意公布这些至关重要的数据。

sentences.en: That's the risk-adjusted data that over 75 percent of hospitals around the country make public.
sentences.zh: 这就是全国各地超过 75% 的医院都会公开的风险调整后数据。

sentences.en: That would help confirm what they're saying.
sentences.zh: 这将有助于证实他们所说的话。

sentences.en: And the Times is still suing to get this.
sentences.zh: 《时报》仍在通过诉讼争取获取这些数据。

sentences.en: Hey, guys.
sentences.zh: 嘿，伙计们。

sentences.en: Can you hear me?
sentences.zh: 你们能听到我说话吗？

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 听到了。

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So we're all here.
sentences.zh: 所以我们都到齐了。

sentences.en: And what have Skylar's parents said about all this?
sentences.zh: 那么斯凯拉的父母对这一切怎么看？

sentences.en: Well, I called them on the phone and told them what I found in my reporting and how the hospital responded to it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我给他们打了电话，告诉了他们我在报道中发现的情况，以及医院对此作何反应。

sentences.en: And they were understandably upset.
sentences.zh: 可以理解的是，他们非常难过。

sentences.en: Do they have concerns about how the surgery is in form or the issues that they were having?
sentences.zh: 他们对这台手术是如何告知的，或者他们当时遇到的问题有什么担忧吗？

sentences.en: You know, it should have been an immediate stop.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这本该立即叫停。

sentences.en: This really, we could have made a decision not to do it at all.
sentences.zh: 真的，我们本可以做出根本不做这台手术的决定。

sentences.en: But because it was presented as, oh, it'd be over and, you know, it angered me that it could have been the Lord.
sentences.zh: 但因为当时被描绘成，哦，很快就会结束，而且，你知道的，这让我很生气，本来可能是上帝的旨意。

sentences.en: It's a situation where, you know, something had to be done.
sentences.zh: 这种情况就是，你知道的，必须得做点什么。

sentences.en: Can't continue to do this.
sentences.zh: 不能再这样下去了。

sentences.en: At the end of the day, that's what we'd be better informed to make a decision.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，这样我们才能获得更好的信息来做出决定。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: He said he could not say that was so kind.
sentences.zh: 他说他不能说这太好了。

sentences.en: He could not hear you.
sentences.zh: 他听不到你说话。

sentences.en: That means you're innocent.
sentences.zh: 这意味着你是无辜的。

sentences.en: That means you're innocent.
sentences.zh: 这意味着你是无辜的。

sentences.en: Excuse me.
sentences.zh: 对不起。

sentences.en: That he should have said you're guilty.
sentences.zh: 他本应该说你有罪。

sentences.en: On Thursday, President Trump claimed that remarks by former special counsel Robert Mueller showed he was innocent,
sentences.zh: 周四，特朗普总统声称前特别检察官罗伯特·穆勒的言论表明他是清白的，

sentences.en: despite Mueller's explicit statement that he could not clear the president of criminal conduct.
sentences.zh: 尽管穆勒明确表示他无法洗清总统的刑事犯罪嫌疑。

sentences.en: I think Mueller is a true never-Trumper.
sentences.zh: 我认为穆勒是一个彻头彻尾的“绝不特朗普”派。

sentences.en: He's somebody that dislikes Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 他是一个不喜欢唐纳德·特朗普的人。

sentences.en: The president described Mueller, without evidence, as biased against him,
sentences.zh: 总统在没有证据的情况下将穆勒描述为对他抱有偏见，

sentences.en: and declared that despite its interference in the 2016 election, that Russia played no role in his victory.
sentences.zh: 并宣称尽管俄罗斯干预了 2016 年大选，但俄罗斯在他的胜利中没有发挥任何作用。

sentences.en: No, Russia did not help me get elected.
